identityReview: Matched Mike / Michael Cannon-Brookes, Atlassian cofounder, with current corporate leadership page, historical joint-founder accounts, UNSW alumni record and SunCable statement. Distinct from his same-named banker father. Australian country label and 1979 birth year supported by Wikipedia; full birthday and birthplace not repeated without stronger direct corroboration.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Opened current leadership page, shareholder letter, Farquhar transition note, company 20-year retrospective and IPO-day post, SEC Trello acquisition announcement, SunCable completion statement, ABC AGL report, UNSW alumni history and Wikipedia.

corrections: UNSW institutional alumni history records Mike BSc 2002 and Scott BSc 2003, with both receiving alumni awards in 2013. No assumption they graduated together in one year. Profile uses institutional degree label and year rather than an unverified exact graduation day or postgraduate qualification.

Company 20-year retrospective explicitly places joint founding and Jira beginnings in 2002. Farquhar’s 2024 retrospective refers loosely to 23 years; this is not used to back-calculate a different incorporation year. Team and cofounder contributions retained.

Farquhar announced April 25, 2024 that August 31 would be his last day as co-CEO and that he would remain a director/special adviser. Timeline dates end of shared leadership, not announcement day. Current leadership page lists Mike CEO and Scott board member, so stale co-CEO labels in older photos are not retained.

November 5, 2026 letter is fiscal 2027 first quarter. Fiscal label is not calendar publication year. Cloud/Rovo progress is reported as company discussion, not an independently reproduced productivity benchmark or claim that all customers use its AI.

January 9, 2017 SEC release announces a definitive agreement to acquire Trello; no claim that transaction closed that day. Trello was an existing collaboration service, not Cannon-Brookes’s sole invention.

December 10, 2015 company IPO-day post explicitly says trading had begun and both founders rang the Nasdaq opening bell. Nasdaq site full open returned 403; planned trading language from earlier pricing release was not the only evidence. Ticker TEAM, not NYSE listing.

SunCable September 7, 2023 statement confirms sale of assets including operating-subsidiary shares to Grok. Distinguish completed acquisition from proposed Australia-Asia Power Link development and projected energy supply. No assertion of completed cable, operating exports or current unaltered project schedule. Do not retain stale co-ownership assumptions from older descriptions involving Andrew Forrest.

ABC May 30, 2022 report documents shareholder opposition and board withdrawal of AGL demerger because required 75% approval was unlikely. Cannon-Brookes was one of opposing investors; no sole-cause claim, completed takeover or vote held and defeated. Article photo caption incorrectly says majority shareholder while text reports 11.28%; majority label rejected and stake not presented as current.
Energy investment and climate advocacy are activities rather than verified delivered emissions reductions. No net worth estimate, private family detail or speculative future project output included.
